resources.string: Keep your charts with your Google account
Sign in to open your charts on lagnaatelier.site and on another phone, and to get more written readings each day. Signing in sends no charts by itself: you choose that next.
Signing out keeps your saved charts on this phone. To end every session at once, sign out everywhere on the website.
Sign-in is not set up in this copy of the app yet. Everything here stays on this phone.
Sign-in for the app is not switched on at lagnaatelier.site yet. Please try again later.
There is no Google account on this phone to sign in with. Add one in the phone\'s settings, then try again.
Sign-in did not go through. Try again.
Sign-in needs the internet. Check your connection and try again.
Too many tries just now. Wait a minute, then try again.
That Google account\'s email address is not verified yet, so it cannot be used to sign in.
Your saved charts are on this phone only.

Keep the charts saved on this phone with your Lagna Atelier account? Their names, birth dates, times and places are stored with your account, so you can open them on the website and on your other devices. You can delete any of them, here or on the website.
Charts you save here are kept on your account too, and charts from your account come to this phone while there is room among the five. Deleting a chart here deletes it from your account.
This phone stops sending and fetching charts. Charts already on your account stay there; you can delete them on the website.
Could not reach your account just now. It will try again.
Kept on this phone and your account
It goes from this phone and from your account.
Optional. Some readings, like your partner\'s planet, are read differently for women and men.
